notes.text: Stage 6 Winkler uses a 1D beam/strip model. True 2D slab-on-grade plate behaviour still needs FE or a dedicated analytical plate solution.

Changing h recalculates both the beam stiffness EI and the EC2 effective depth d. For patch or point loading, a stiffer strip can bridge farther and develop a larger ULS moment, so As,req can increase if MEd grows faster than the lever-arm benefit.

Model interpretation is beam/strip along its length: x runs along the member, b is the section/contact width perpendicular to that run, and full-length uniform loading mainly represents settlement rather than local bending.
beta*L is below pi, so finite-beam behaviour matters. A numerical beam-on-Winkler solve is therefore used instead of relying on the infinite-beam shortcut.
Default ks derivation uses Es = E_oed and ν = 0 for consistency with the oedometric stiffness route. Switch to drained Young modulus mode if a project-specific conversion is preferred.
Reinforcement is checked over the entered model width b = 0.60 m, so As is reported as total steel over that width. Use b = 1.00 m for standard mm2/m slab-strip output.
